units: Pesik. R. s. 8 (ref. to Zeph. I, 12) מוציא אני אותה לח׳ I shall lead her out to liberty (v. preced.); a. fr.— masc. free, exempt.

<cite ref="Niddah 61b:15">Nidd. 61ᵇ</cite>, a. e. (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 88:6">Ps. LXXXVIII, 6</cite>) <he>כיון … נעשה ח׳ וכ׳</he> when one is dead, one is free from religious duties. Tanḥ. Emor 2 (ref. to <he>ויתחפש</he>, <cite ref="I Samuel 28:8">I Sam. XXVIII, 8</cite>) <he>נעשה ה׳ מן המלכות</he> divested himself of the (insignia of) government; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26:7">Lev. R. s. 26</cite> (not <he>למלכות</he>); Midr. Sam. ch. XXIV, v. <cite ref="Q00084"><he>פָּגָנִיקָא</he></cite>; a. fr.
